entries.source: The target is infected with a corrosive worm, reducing blight and acid resistance by %d%%. When the effect ends, the worm will explode, dealing %d acid damage in a 4 radius ball. This damage will increase by %d%% of all damage taken while under torment
entries.target: 目标被腐蚀蠕虫感染，减少 %d%% 酸性和枯萎抗性，效果结束后，蠕虫将爆炸，在半径 4 范围内造成 %d 酸性伤害。效果期间所受伤害的 %d%% 会加到爆炸伤害上。

entries.source:
The target is out of phase with reality, increasing defense by %d, resist all by %d%%, and reducing the duration of detrimental timed effects by %d%%.
These effects cap at 40%%.
entries.target:
目标脱离了现实相位，增加 %d 闪避，%d%% 全体伤害抗性并减少 %d%% 所有负面状态的持续时间。
闪避上限为 40 点，全体伤害抗性与负面状态持续时间缩减上限为 40%%。
